richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity there may be contact or a reduced clearance between the fuel Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. Under wet conditions there is a possibility that this insufficient clearance may lead to water infiltration creating an electrical arc which could trigger a thermal event such as overheating. In the worst-case scenario this could result in a risk of fire in the engine compartment.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. In addition check the distance between the fuel Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. If the distance is less than 10 mm re-position the pipe or replace the pipe if damaged.
richiami.titolo: Alternator Protection

richiami.rimedio: Replace the connector brake pipe and seals.

richiami.rimedio: Modify the electrical wiring fit a re-rated protective fuse and install modified mounting bushes.

richiami.difetto: Gradual loosening of the front suspension may result in noise and deterioration of the suspension and handling characteristics.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the original equipment front suspension reinforcing plates and fasteners with modified components.

richiami.difetto: The metal brake pipe between the master cylinder and the ABS unit may chafe on a cable bracket.  A seriously damaged brake pipe will reduce the braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Check brake pipe condition and clearances.  Renew any damaged pipes.

richiami.rimedio: Fit two additional support clips to the fuel delivery pipe.

richiami.difetto: Possible failure of low pressure power steering pipe connection with leakage of fluid and loss of power assistance.

richiami.titolo: POWER ASSISTED STEERING CONCERN

richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check and modify the cables.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for rerouting of the rear brake hoses. Any hose found to be damaged will be replaced.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and protect the wiring harness by fitting a length of protective strip to the lower edge of the cross shaft cover.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FIRE RISK

richiami.difetto: On some cars a hose longer than specified could have been erroneously fitted with consequent possible interference with the engine. Such interference could in the long run cause the perforation of the hose oil leakage and a potential risk of fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and a check on the length of the hose. In cases where the hose is found to be too long it will be shortened to the right length or if damaged will be replaced.
